description: This file contains the implementation of a Smarty internal plugin class that compiles expressions for printing variables or expressions within Smarty templates. It defines how expressions are processed, modified, filtered, and outputted in the compiled PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Print_Expression
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling Smarty template expressions that produce output, handling modifiers, filters, and escaping mechanisms.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to output an expression or variable with optional modifiers, filtering, and escaping, based on template attributes and parameters.

methods.name: compile_variable_filter
methods.description: Helper method to compile variable filters for use in the template output, resolving plugins if available.
